name: writeSuccessPostWithdrawals
comment: The post-withdrawals chain: two segments between two frozen predicates. 0x156e8 is the exit of the post-transactions segment and 0x15754 is the hashes loop's entry; both are merged and stay as they are. The one junction between them, 0x15744, is a hand-written boundary today and is inferred here.
